history.title: Work through the discoveries
history.intro: Two cities’ shadows, late-arriving light, galaxies moving against expectations. Become the observer in ten stories, following each question toward a discovery.
history.method: Work through nine scenes in each story, then return to its opening question and gather what you discovered. Press and hold a dotted term for its meaning.
history.noReview: Nothing to review yet. Start with a story that interests you.

history.numberHelp: Enter a number only. Scientific notation such as 1.2e5 is supported.
history.hintNote: Hints open one step at a time. The number used is saved with your answer.
